=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/propagate_consumer_secrets.sh:117-128 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The guard `${PROPAGATE_TARGETS// /}` strips only literal spaces, so a tabs-only or newlines-only value enters the tokenize branch, yields an empty TARGETS, and does not fall back to the registry.
  WHY: No secrets are propagated and the script exits 0, contradicting the documented empty-input fallback. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet), BLOCKER (gemini), MAJOR (minimax, luna, glm); highest used.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1373 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_mt_now_ms` fallback runs `$(date -u +%s)` inside an arithmetic expansion with no guard.
  WHY: If `date` fails or prints nothing, the arithmetic error can abort the `_mt_release` pass under errexit. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm), MAJOR (gemini, minimax); highest used.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh:40-53 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `review_head_checkout_now_ms` accepts any all-digit `date +%s%3N` output (`^[0-9]+$`), including 10-digit seconds.
  WHY: Where `%3N` is ignored, duration_ms, fetch_ms and switch_ms are about 1000x too small. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm), MAJOR (gemini, minimax); highest used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36-49 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_poll_cycle_now_ms` accepts any all-digit `date +%s%3N` output, including bare seconds.
  WHY: elapsed_ms in ORCH_POLL_CYCLE_SUMMARY and ORCH_POLL_PROJECT_TIMING would be about 1000x too small. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm), MAJOR (gemini, minimax); highest used.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:410-426 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The verdict-comment marker is extracted with `last` on split and keeps `\r` if the body uses CRLF.
  WHY: The case pattern at line 745 would then fail to match and a verdict would be reported as failed instead of reconciled. Sonnet and glm checked this and found it not demonstrable.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh:156,313 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA` is written to `$GITHUB_ENV` twice.
  WHY: Last-write-wins makes the final value correct, but the redundant write is confusing.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2969-2970 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An unset or empty `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` yields the odd path `/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh` before the `-f` fallback.
  WHY: The `-f` check makes it harmless; the effect is cosmetic logging.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:55-66 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_orch_poll_cycle_sleep` records the duration only when it matches `^[0-9]{1,9}$`, so longer values go to the unknown branch.
  WHY: No current caller sleeps that long, so this is future-proofing only.
- (no changed file; check run copilot-pull-request-reviewer 42661072645) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The copilot-pull-request-reviewer check fails with `custom_instructions_too_large` (Prompt too big after adding system message).
  WHY: The external reviewer tool fails before producing a review, and no hunk in the diff is the cause. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm), BLOCKER (gemini); highest used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Log per-cycle wait_ms, API time, decision time, candidate count, and terminal reason."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (ORCH_POLL_CYCLE_SUMMARY and ORCH_POLL_PROJECT_TIMING)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: ORCH_POLL_CYCLE_SUMMARY carries only elapsed_ms, projects_seen, projects_processed, sleep_ms, exit_code and terminal_reason, with no API time, decision time or candidate count, and sleep_ms covers only the instrumented sleep sites.
- requirement: "Log candidate disposition, distinct file-list fetches, pages, cache hits, active-listing calls, and elapsed/API time."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh (MERGE_TRAIN_RELEASE_SUMMARY in _mt_release, line ~1527)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The summary has file_list_fetches, file_list_cache_hits, active_listing_calls and whole-pass elapsed_ms, but no pagination-page count and no separate API time.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/propagate_consumer_secrets.sh:~115-128 (guard at about line 117) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard strips only literal spaces, so a tabs-only or newlines-only value yields an empty array and TARGETS does not fall back to REGISTRY.
  WHY: Nothing is propagated and the run can exit 0, contradicting the changelog's fallback claim. The old unquoted expansion behaved the same way, so this is not a regression.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1373 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fallback runs `date` inside an arithmetic expansion with no guard.
  WHY: A `date` failure would abort the release pass under errexit. Line 1400 already runs `date` unguarded, so the added exposure is small.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh:~40-53 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~36-49 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `^[0-9]+$` check on `date +%s%3N` output accepts bare seconds, unlike `_mt_now_ms`, which requires `^[0-9]{13,}$`.
  WHY: Timing diagnostics would be about 1000x too small on a `date` that ignores `%3N`. GNU date on the runners supports it.
- none (check run copilot-pull-request-reviewer 42661072645) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The check fails with `custom_instructions_too_large`.
  WHY: It is an external tool failure that cannot be mapped to any hunk, so no code fix applies.
- Not reported: the duplicate INITIAL_HEAD_SHA writes, the unset SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR path and the CRLF concern in activation_verify.sh (explained as non-issues).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE.
